name: Emilia Forgan
original_name: エミーリア フォルガン
source:
The granddaughter of the head of the wealthy Forgan family, and the youngest of the three sisters.

She is always timid and reserved, even around her elder sisters.
Unlike Dietlinde, she treats Hayate and the others with proper courtesy.

[b]“I—I’m, um, a little weak physically… I often end up falling ill…”[/b]
